verdict.rationale: Databricks' own Trust Center compliance page documents compliance attestations, including a SOC 2 Type II report available to customers and a broader certification portfolio. That gives security reviewers a first-party starting point. However, the evidence does not name HIPAA or PCI attestations, so only one of the three named frameworks is confirmed. missing for 10: explicit HIPAA attestation evidence, explicit PCI DSS attestation evidence, detail on how reports are accessed or scoped (e.g., per cloud/region), independent corroboration
